classification.classification_reason: The article is primarily about Waymo's suspension of driverless taxi rides on freeways in the US, following a ban by California.

content.title: Waymo Suspends Driverless Taxi Rides on US Freeways
content.caption: Waymo has stopped offering driverless taxi rides on freeways across the US indefinitely.

slides.heading: Waymo Suspends Driverless Taxi Rides on US Freeways
slides.text: Waymo has stopped offering driverless taxi rides on freeways across the US indefinitely.

slides.heading: California Ban on Freeways
slides.text: California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from its freeways following recent traffic incidents.
